title: Quietly Dense Ethiopian Chicken Ye Beg Alichta
description: A hearty and aromatic Ethiopian dish featuring roasted chicken in a rich massaman-paste sauce, cooked to perfection in a tandoor, Whole30-friendly and dense with flavor, this ye-beg-alicha is a must-try for any food enthusiast.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together massaman curry paste, coconut oil, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the marinade and mix well.
Add the chicken thighs to the marinade and toss to coat, making sure the chicken is fully covered.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Place the chicken in the preheated tandoor and roast for 35-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the skin is crispy.
While the chicken is cooking, whisk together lemon juice and chicken broth in a small bowl.
After the chicken has cooked for 25 minutes, brush the lemon juice and chicken broth mixture evenly over the chicken.
Continue cooking the chicken for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the sauce is caramelized and the chicken is fully cooked.
